* '''Original''' ([[Eighth Brother]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-eighthbrother-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Eighth%20Brother.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy or move as a 'react' to same site as a 'Hatred' card. During your move phase, unless alone, may return one of your Inquisitors here (and all cards on them) to owner's hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 25 October 2022): Players Committee card image, 25 October 2022: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-eighthbrother.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9463f35/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/hires/eighthbrother.png Holotable commit 9463f35 “Set 2 high res plus extras”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy or move as a 'react' to same site as a 'Hatred' card. During your move phase, unless alone, may return one of your Inquisitors here (and all cards on them) to owner's hand.” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered with the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the concept credit changed from “Original concept by Jake Kessler” to “Original concept by Rogue Kessler”; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
